text: Bear works at a music store and cannot tell his friend Nikki how he feels. Instead he buys her [a novelty toy that grants one wish when snapped|images|holy and occult objects] and, alone, [wishes she loved him more than anyone in the world|trigger|calling on unseen powers]. Nikki comes to his door that night. Within days she is [taping the front door shut and watching him sleep|wants|a lover to possess], and a voice on the toy's helpline explains that [the wish ends only when he dies|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
